title: Add AnnotationsOr field to hooks schema for OR-matching
body:
Add `AnnotationsOr` to the hook `When` struct, it behaves similar to `Annotations` but matches if any single entry matches, instead of requiring all of them. Bumped schema to v1.1.0 and v1.0.0 and v0.1.0 now forward into it via `Read()` which is what v0.1.0 used before for v1.0.0 

### Test
`go test ./pkg/hooks/...`

<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

comments.body: I have no opinion on the implementation (and I didn’t read it ~at all yet), but please write down _why_ we are adding this (after previously having the feature and deprecating it, if I understand the situation). Is there a new use case which was not anticipated when deprecating it? Was the depreciation always considered a mistake? Purely for some kind of conceptual symmetry? Something else?

The old `Or` field was never user facing and is internally used to convert `0.1.0` hooks into the `1.0.0 `struct for backwards compatibility. The driving force for this was HPC users who felt that AND was too limiting and would want some hooks firing on one annotation, confirmed with @mheon
For why we deprecated in the first case... I honestly have no memory, the decision was pre-Podman 1.0 so ~8 years ago...
